snippet.title: Magnetic Catch | Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Got hooked? 🧲️🎣 https://store.steampowered.com/app/4324710/Magnetic_Catch?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_content=video

Magnetic Catch is coming to Steam! A cozy magnet fishing adventure full of rusty scrap and hidden treasures. Explore murky canals, quiet lakes, and forgotten places... you never know what you'll pull up next.

🧲 Clean, craft, or trade your finds
🔧 Upgrade your magnet and gear
🗺️ Explore beautiful yet mysterious places and uncover their hidden secrets

Wishlist now to get notified when the demo is released!

Socials: https://linktr.ee/gameandcode
